verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Weave capturing function inputs and outputs into traces, but nothing documents masking or redacting sensitive data before it is stored. The only related item is Guardrails' PII detection scorer, which detects and classifies PII rather than redacting it from stored traces, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can mask or redact sensitive data before it is stored in traces
